tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The UGREEN 70503 M.2 NVMe to PCIe 3.0 x4 Adapter Express Card is an ideal solution for upgrading your desktop with a high-speed NVMe SSD. Designed for M-Key M.2 NVMe SSDs, this adapter utilizes a PCIe 3.0 x4 interface to deliver data transfer speeds of up to 32Gbps, ensuring faster boot times, quicker application loading, and improved overall system responsiveness.


Compatible with 2230, 2242, 2260, and 2280 M.2 NVMe SSDs, the UGREEN 70503 supports installation in PCIe x4, x8, and x16 slots, making it suitable for desktops, workstations, gaming PCs, and servers. Its premium PCB design ensures stable signal transmission and efficient heat dissipation for reliable long-term performance.


Whether you're upgrading an older PC without an M.2 slot or expanding your storage capacity, the UGREEN 70503 M.2 NVMe to PCIe Adapter offers a simple, reliable, and cost-effective solution.


Key Features


  • Supports M-Key M.2 NVMe SSDs
  • PCIe 3.0 x4 interface with bandwidth up to 32Gbps
  • Compatible with PCIe x4, x8, and x16 slots
  • Supports M.2 SSD sizes: 2230 / 2242 / 2260 / 2280
  • Backward compatible with PCIe Gen2 and Gen1
  • High-quality PCB for stable and reliable performance
  • Easy installation with plug-and-play support
  • Ideal for gaming PCs, workstations, desktop upgrades, and servers
